name: logreg_raw
hypothesis: Linear baseline sets the floor; the main churn drivers (contract, tenure, charges) are largely additive, so it should already be competitive.

name: rf_raw
hypothesis: Bagged trees capture interactions without tuning; expected to beat the linear model on ROC-AUC, less clearly on PR-AUC.

name: hgb_raw
spec: hist_gb / raw / l2_regularization=0, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=0, max_iter=200
hypothesis: Boosting usually wins on tabular data of this size; expected best PR-AUC of the baselines.

name: lgbm_raw
spec: lightgbm / raw / colsample_bytree=1, learning_rate=0.05, min_child_samples=20, n_estimators=300, num_leaves=31, reg_lambda=0
hypothesis: Leaf-wise boosting with the same defaults as hist_gb; checks whether the implementation matters more than the family.

name: logreg_engineered
hypothesis: Explicit tenure buckets, add-on count and charge ratio encode known churn patterns that logreg otherwise has to learn from one-hot columns.

name: lightgbm_engineered
spec: lightgbm / engineered / colsample_bytree=1, learning_rate=0.05, min_child_samples=20, n_estimators=300, num_leaves=31, reg_lambda=0
hypothesis: Explicit tenure buckets, add-on count and charge ratio encode known churn patterns that lightgbm otherwise has to learn from one-hot columns.

name: logreg_minimal
hypothesis: If seven columns hold most of the signal, the simpler model is easier to deploy and explain; expected small PR-AUC loss.

name: logreg_raw_regularised
hypothesis: Stronger L2 regularisation should reduce variance of the one-hot coefficients.

name: lightgbm_raw_regularised
spec: lightgbm / raw / colsample_bytree=1, learning_rate=0.03, min_child_samples=40, n_estimators=400, num_leaves=15, reg_lambda=1
hypothesis: Fewer leaves and larger minimum leaves should reduce overfitting seen in the defaults. If so, the gap to logreg at default settings was overfitting, not a family limit.

name: logreg_raw_balanced
hypothesis: Balanced class weights push the model to rank rare churners higher; may raise recall@10% at some cost in calibration.
